register: Vous throughout (about 770 strings use vous/votre/vos, none use tu), which matches Feedly, Inoreader, Apple and Google in French; buttons and menu items use the infinitive or a noun phrase (Enregistrer, Ajouter un site, Marquer comme lu), instructions in running text use the vous imperative (Saisissez, Choisissez, Cliquez), and strings that drop into tu are flagged (medium).

terms.note: Catalog majority (about 1,085 of 1,120 strings). Story view → vue Article; Story title → titre de l’article; Story trainer → entraîneur d’articles. Also avoid where it means this concept: histoire.
A subscription is a site in UI labels; feed is the technical feed.
Invariable plural. RSS feed → flux RSS; feed list → liste des flux; feed view → vue Flux.
Parent folder → dossier parent.

terms.use: non lu / non lus (agreeing with articles)
terms.note: Unread only → Non lus uniquement; Next unread story → Article non lu suivant. Slider label Unread → Non lus.

avoid: Lire les articles / Lire des articles (for the Read Stories folder)
terms.note: Read Stories is the folder of stories already read: Articles lus, never the imperative. Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens a feed to read it: Lire %@. Mark newer/older as read → Marquer les plus récents / les plus anciens comme lus.
Unsave → Retirer des articles enregistrés (short: Retirer des enregistrés); Saved Stories folder → Articles enregistrés.
%d shares → %d partages.
Product name, never translated; follow the English capitalization of each string.

Matches the catalog and the German/Spanish decisions. Intelligence training → entraînement de l’intelligence (tolerated: entraînement intelligent); Train this story/site → Entraîner sur cet article / Entraîner ce site; Story trainer → entraîneur d’articles; Site trainer → entraîneur du site.

The catalog had seven different words for the Focus level. Slider: Tous / Non lus / Prioritaires. Focus stories → articles prioritaires; Unread + Focus → Non lus + prioritaires; 'in Focus mode/view' → parmi les articles prioritaires (or: en mode Prioritaires where a mode name is needed). Verbs in prose: focus or hide → mettre en avant ou masquer.

terms.use: J’aime / Je n’aime pas; Hide → Masquer
terms.note: Hide is the level above J’aime (formerly Super dislike, then Je déteste): Masquer, quoted in sentences (« Masquer » l’emporte sur tout). The trainer's 'beats' means Like outranks Dislike: l’emporte sur (or a > sign); '(like wins)' → (J’aime l’emporte). 'Positive?' is an 'Are you sure?' title → Vous êtes sûr ?

Hide is the strongest training level, above Like and Dislike (it was called Super dislike): a story that matches it is always hidden, whatever else it matches. Use the same word as the Hide button in the training controls, and quote it in sentences like the other level names (« Masquer » l’emporte sur tout). The old Super dislike names are retired.
Reserved for hiding stories; do not use it for muting sites.
Prompt classifier → classificateur par consigne; Regex classifiers → classificateurs regex / par expressions régulières.

terms.use: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro
avoid: Archive Premium / Archives Premium / l’archive Premium (for the plan)
premium lowercase as the plan name
terms.note: Plan names stay in English as product names, matching the App Store and Play Store products and the German and Spanish decisions. Use them without an article (Passer à Premium Archive) or with offre/abonnement (l’offre Premium Archive, un abonnement Premium Archive). The story archive feature itself (not the plan) is l’archive / les archives. Generic 'premium feature/account' → fonctionnalité Premium / compte Premium.

terms.use: Passer à (plan) / passer à une offre supérieure / Mettre à niveau (button)
terms.note: Upgrade from Premium → Passer à une offre supérieure.
Réglages is Apple's own word for Settings on iOS and is tolerated there; do not churn between Paramètres and Réglages.
Sentence case. Fil d’actualités (plural) is tolerated.

avoid: Tous les articles du site (= all stories of one site)
terms.note: It means stories from all sites, not all stories of this site. Open All Site Stories → Ouvrir les articles de tous les sites.
Stories from sites that publish rarely (below a stories-per-month threshold); the stories are not infrequent and it is not one site.

terms.concept: Widely Read / Long Reads / Good Reads / Global Shared
terms.use: Articles les plus lus / Lectures longues / Bonnes lectures / Articles partagés à l’échelle mondiale
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books. Long Reads: Lectures longues is the catalog plurality; longs formats in prose is fine.

Catalog plurality (briefing 76 vs résumé 36). Résumé is reserved for summaries (Ask AI summaries, the briefing's summary style and length). Morning/Afternoon/Evening Briefing → Briefing du matin / de l’après-midi / du soir; Weekly → Briefing hebdomadaire; Twice-daily → Briefing biquotidien. 'Brief' (a summary length next to Medium/Detailed) → Bref / Court; 'Editorial' (a narrative style) → Éditorial.
Catalog majority (93 vs 29). Story tags → tags de l’article; Saved story tags → tags des articles enregistrés.

terms.use: Découvrir / sites similaires or sites associés
terms.note: Both similaires and associés are fine; do not churn between them.

avoid: Me suit (singular, for the Following Me tab)
terms.note: Friends tabs, as on Twitter and Instagram in French: I'm Following → Mes abonnements; Following Me → Mes abonnés (must be distinguishable). Follow-up (Ask AI) → question complémentaire.

terms.use: mettre en sourdine / en sourdine / réactiver (unmute)
avoid: Masquer (for mute: clashes with hiding stories)
terms.note: Catalog plurality. Mute Sites → Mettre des sites en sourdine; Muted → En sourdine; Unmute → Réactiver.

terms.use: vue Flux / vue Texte / vue Article / vue Originale (vue du site d’origine)
terms.note: Original site → site d’origine. Affichage texte is tolerated in prose.

avoid: Interroger l’IA as the feature name
terms.note: The button on every platform already says Demander à l’IA, so the feature is named the same way in prose: la fonction « Demander à l’IA ». Full sentences like 'Posez vos questions à l’IA' are fine when not naming the feature.

terms.use: compte / Se connecter / Se déconnecter / S’inscrire / Créer un compte / Connexion (noun)
terms.note: The welcome page buttons were fixed to Se connecter; keep sentence case.

terms.use: e-mail / adresse e-mail / mot de passe

terms.note: Premium trial → essai Premium.
'%(shortcut)s to send' means press the shortcut to send: %(shortcut)s pour envoyer.
Flux Web with a capital W is also correct French; do not churn between Web and web.
Clustered story → article regroupé.

terms.use: Plus récents que : / Plus anciens que :
terms.note: Newer:/Older: are date bounds. '< 5/month' means fewer than 5 stories a month, not a price.
French 'il y a' takes the bare unit unchanged (il y a 3 jours), so the server's bare units and the clients' wrappers combine correctly.

terms.use: French guillemets « … » for quotation; sentence case labels; ’ apostrophe; space before ? ! : ; and inside « »
terms.note: The catalog consistently uses a regular space before ? ! : ; and inside « » (about 450 strings, one non-breaking). Converting those to U+202F/U+00A0 is a mechanical global pass, not per-string findings, so regular spaces are not flagged on their own; missing spaces are. ASCII apostrophes (33 strings) are tolerated and fixed only in passing. Thousands separator is a space (1 024), decimal comma, currency after the number (36 $/an). Ellipsis follows the English.

terms.use: count first, singular noun for 0 and 1
terms.note: French uses the singular for 0 and 1 (0 article, 1 article).

Layout option next to Liste, Grille, Magazine. Partagé is the consumer French for split view (écran partagé) and is what the welcome page already uses; it is only ambiguous with 'partagés' (shared stories) out of context, never in the layout picker.

terms.use: consigne (the text a prompt classifier or image classifier scores stories against)
avoid: prompt in UI labels for classifiers
terms.note: Classifier UI and server errors say consigne (classificateur par consigne, Consigne manquante). The MCP feature's 'prompt templates' is a different concept kept as 'modèles de prompts', since prompts is the MCP primitive name.
